description: Score how hard a text is to read with three standard formulas: Flesch Kincaid grade level (plus the Flesch reading ease score), Gunning Fog index and SMOG index. Each grade is roughly a US school grade, so 12 is the end of high school and 16 is a college degree. Input: text.     SMOG is built for samples of 30 sentences or more, so on shorter text the tool still returns a number but marks it as less reliable. Example: "Give me the Flesch Kincaid, Gunning Fog and SMOG scores for this paper.
name: readability_scores
title: Readability scores
